sideEffects.e: Blurred vision, constipation, memory problems, dry mouth

pearls: Its anticholinergic effects come from **M1 blockade**, not H1; the idea that all antihistamines are anticholinergic arose because most potent ones also block M1.
H1-antagonist hypnotics have only **anecdotal** tolerance and no withdrawal, dependence or rebound.
Works by **reducing arousal** (blocking histamine) rather than boosting sleep drive; hypnotic threshold for histamine blockade is thought to be about **80%** occupancy.
